name: Miscellaneous Movement Disorder Due to Genetic Neurodegenerative Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Neurodegenerative Movement Disorder Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of progressive movement disorder characterized by dystonia, chorea, or parkinsonism
Identification of pathogenic mutation in a known neurodegenerative disease gene
Neuroimaging evidence of neurodegeneration such as basal ganglia atrophy or iron accumulation
Exclusion of acquired or secondary causes of movement disorders

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Progressive movement disorder with genetic confirmation and exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for definitive diagnosis; clinical heterogeneity is common.

pathognomonic.notes: Sustained muscle contractions causing abnormal postures

common.notes: Progressive impairment in memory and executive function
Slurred or slow speech due to motor impairment
Increased muscle tone leading to stiffness

occasional.notes: Sensory loss or paresthesia in distal limbs
Mood disturbances associated with chronic illness
Insomnia or REM sleep behavior disorder

rare.notes: Irregular heart rhythms secondary to autonomic involvement

laboratory: Elevated neurofilament light chain in CSF
Normal routine blood tests excluding secondary causes
imaging: T2* MRI sequences demonstrating iron accumulation
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes associated with neurodegeneration (e.g., HTT, ATP13A2, PLA2G6)
other: Electromyography may show mild peripheral neuropathy

distinguishingFeatures: CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion in HTT gene
Family history of autosomal dominant inheritance

redFlags: Rapid progression of movement disorder within months
Early onset cognitive impairment before motor symptoms
Family history of similar neurodegenerative disorders
references: Orphanet: Miscellaneous movement disorder due to genetic neurodegenerative disease, ORPHA:307058
Marras C, et al. Movement Disorders in Neurodegenerative Diseases. Lancet Neurol. 2020.
Klein C, Westenberger A. Genetics of Parkinson's Disease. Cold Spring Harb Perspect Med. 2012.
